title: MewTwoChainz
bio:
Safari Zone with MewTwoChainz

*Monthly*

Hailing from the Star City, deep in Virginia’s Blue Ridge Mountains, Baltimore-based DJ MewTwoChainz draws inspiration from the crossroads of Appalachia and global club culture.

Beginning his journey behind the decks in Japan, he developed his sound across dance floors from Tokyo to Osaka before returning to the East Coast as an emerging selector.

A junglist at heart, his sets move through jungle, bass, techno, house, and regional club sounds, often incorporating ragga, tribal percussion, and unexpected edits. SAFARI ZONE is his exploration of the wildest corners of the dance floor.
